name: 混沌爵士
setDescription4pc: 施放特殊技或连携技后，装备者的攻击力提升，持续12秒。
setDescription4pcEn: After using a Special Skill or Chain Attack, the equipper's ATK increases for 12s.

name: 极地金属
setDescription4pc: 普通攻击和冲刺攻击造成的伤害提升。触发闪避反击时，额外提升冰属性伤害。
setDescription4pcEn: Increases DMG dealt by Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks. When triggering Dodge Counter, additionally increases Ice DMG.

name: 尖牙金属
setDescription4pc: 命中处于物理异常状态下的敌人时，暴击率提升。
setDescription4pcEn: When hitting enemies under Physical Anomaly, CRIT Rate increases.

name: 震撼巨星
setDescription4pc: 普通攻击、闪避反击、快速支援命中敌人时，目标受到的眩晕值额外提升。
setDescription4pcEn: When Basic Attacks, Dodge Counters, or Quick Assists hit enemies, the target accumulates additional Daze.

name: 自由布鲁斯
setDescription4pc: 施放特殊技命中敌人时，目标的异常积蓄抗性降低，持续12秒。
setDescription4pcEn: When Special Skill hits an enemy, the target's Anomaly Buildup RES decreases for 12s.

name: 荷尔蒙朋克
setDescription4pc: 进入战斗时，自动触发一次攻击力提升效果，持续一定时间。
setDescription4pcEn: Upon entering combat, automatically triggers an ATK boost effect for a set duration.

name: 木偶师电音
setDescription4pc: 触发暴击时，恢复少量能量，每秒最多触发一次。
setDescription4pcEn: Upon triggering a CRIT hit, recovers a small amount of Energy. Can trigger once per second max.

name: 摇摆爵士
setDescription4pc: 发动连携技时，为队伍中其他角色回复能量。
setDescription4pcEn: When triggering Chain Attack, recovers Energy for other team members.

name: 灵魂摇滚
setDescription4pc: 受到伤害时，获得护盾，持续一定时间。
setDescription4pcEn: Upon taking damage, gains a shield for a set duration.

name: 烈焰金属
setDescription4pc: 命中燃烧状态下的敌人时，暴击率提升。
setDescription4pcEn: When hitting enemies affected by Burn, CRIT Rate increases.

name: 雷电金属
setDescription4pc: 命中触电状态下的敌人时，攻击力提升。
setDescription4pcEn: When hitting enemies affected by Shock, ATK increases.

name: 河豚电音
setDescription4pc: 施放终结技时，穿透率额外提升，持续一定时间。
setDescription4pcEn: When using Ultimate, PEN Ratio additionally increases for a set duration.

name: 枝刃之歌
setDescription4pc: 触发冰属性异常时，装备者的暴击伤害提升。
setDescription4pcEn: When triggering Ice Anomaly, equipper's CRIT DMG increases.

name: 混沌金属
setDescription4pc: 触发以太属性异常时，装备者的异常精通提升。
setDescription4pcEn: When triggering Ether Anomaly, equipper's Anomaly Mastery increases.

name: 原型朋克
setDescription4pc: 发动快速支援或招架支援时，为队伍提供减伤效果。
setDescription4pcEn: When triggering Quick Assist or Defensive Assist, grants damage reduction to the team.

name: 暗影和声
setDescription4pc: 队伍中任意角色施放连携技时，装备者获得攻击力提升。
setDescription4pcEn: When any team member triggers Chain Attack, equipper gains ATK boost.

name: 星光之声
setDescription4pc: 施放快速支援时，装备者的攻击力提升，持续一定时间。
setDescription4pcEn: When triggering Quick Assist, equipper's ATK increases for a set duration.

name: 法厄同旋律
setDescription4pc: 触发属性紊乱时，装备者的异常精通额外提升。
setDescription4pcEn: When triggering Disorder, equipper's Anomaly Mastery additionally increases.

name: 巅峰之王
setDescription4pc: 施放强化特殊技时，装备者获得暴击伤害提升。
setDescription4pcEn: When triggering Enhanced Special Skill, equipper gains CRIT DMG boost.

name: 云灰异闻
setDescription4pc: 触发属性紊乱时，全队异常精通提升。
setDescription4pcEn: When triggering Disorder, all team members' Anomaly Mastery increases.

name: 黎明之华
setDescription4pc: 装备者受到攻击时，获得伤害减免和能量回复。
setDescription4pcEn: When attacked, equipper gains DMG reduction and Energy Regen.

name: 月光摇篮曲
setDescription4pc: 施放连携技时，全队回复能量。
setDescription4pcEn: When triggering Chain Attack, all team members recover Energy.

name: 仙境兔宝
setDescription4pc: 施放基本攻击时，装备者获得物理伤害和攻击力提升。
setDescription4pcEn: When using Basic Attack, equipper gains Physical DMG and ATK boost.

name: 缚锁笔记
setDescription4pc: 施放快速支援时，装备者冲击力额外提升。
setDescription4pcEn: When triggering Quick Assist, equipper's Impact additionally increases.
